content.text:
The bug is fixed: all four cases from the report now come out the same as in CommonMark 0.31.2. All tests pass (1787 spec tests, 46 unit tests). I couldn't run the TypeScript type check or the linter because permission for those commands was denied. The esbuild build works.

**Cause.** Before parsing the inline text, `Lexer.inlineTokens` makes a copy of it with links hidden, so the emphasis code doesn't pick up a `*` or `_` from inside a link. Every `[text][ref]` whose `ref` is defined got hidden there. But a reference link whose text holds another link is rejected later (links can't contain links), and its brackets are then treated as plain text. Its span stayed hidden anyway, so the emphasis code never saw the delimiters and printed them as literal asterisks.

**Fix (`src/Lexer.ts`):**
- I moved the hiding logic into a helper, `maskInline`. What it does hasn't changed.
- When the lexer is at a `[` that matches the reference-link pattern but wasn't turned into a link, it now re-hides just that span from its contents. Links inside it stay hidden (both inline links and reference links, so example 533 works), but the emphasis around them is found again. Text outside that span is left alone.

**Tests:**
- I added a unit test in `test/unit/marked.test.js` covering `*`, `_`, `**`, and the inner reference-link case.
- CommonMark example 533 was marked as a known failure in both spec files (`test/specs/{commonmark,gfm}/commonmark.0.31.2.json`). It passes now, so I removed that marker.
